transport: RS-232 at the controller's 8-pin Molex aux port (pin 8 = controller TX → Pi RX, pin 7 = controller RX ← Pi TX, pin 2 = ground; Evolution 2.0 adds pin 3 = +12 V accessory, pin 4 = RS-232 ground, pins 5/6 = RS-485 to the built-in WiFi module) · Modbus RTU, function 0x03 read / 0x06 and 0x10 write · 9600 8N1 · slave 0x9D · NOT RS-485 despite the family filename; a TTL↔RS-232 level converter (MAX3232-
blocks: 0x0000–0x0062 base + status (0x0001 alarm/status, 4 bytes spanning 0x0001–0x0002) · 0x01f4 serial number (5 words) · 0x0208–0x025a settings (mostly EvoLC) · 0x05ed–0x05f7 sensors and EvoAC current · 0x07e5 / 0x07ed / 0x1f75 Power Zone 200 only · command path is an indexed-write pair: value → 0x0004, then target index → 0x0003

downgradedOnReview: Could not refute the underlying evidence — every primary source exists and says what the claim quotes, verbatim. I downloaded genmon master's genmonlib/generac_evolution.py (5613 lines) and confirmed: a single self.BaseRegisters (line 154) + self.PrimeRegisters (line 287) with no per-model address branching in the poll list; the literal comment "# This should cover the guardian line" at line 943 directly above ModelL
gotchas: NO GENERAC VENDOR DOCUMENT WAS FOUND for the residential Nexus/Evolution protocol, and none is referenced by any implementation. Every address here is reverse-engineered. genmon's own register table carries 126 hedges ('Unknown', 'possibly', 'I believe', 'appears to', 'Looks like some status bits') — that density is it

THE TWO OTHER IMPLEMENTATIONS I FOUND ARE DERIVED FROM genmon, NOT INDEPENDENT — so this does not reach community-crosschecked. sofar/esphome_configs `config/generac-cbd934.yaml` reproduces genmon's code comments verbatim as ESPHome sensor names ('Hours until Service A', 'Date Service A Due'). pengels22/home_controller

FREQUENCY SCALE — CONTRADICTION INSIDE genmon ITSELF. The comment beside register 0x0008 in `BaseRegisters` reads 'Freq - value includes Hz to the tenths place i.e. 59.9 Hz' (implying ÷10), but `GetFrequency()` applies `Divider=10.0` ONLY for Evolution Liquid Cooled / Synergy / PowerZone200 and explicitly uses `Divisor

AC CURRENT AND POWER ARE NOT TRUSTWORTHY WITHOUT BENCH CALIBRATION. genmon's per-model current-divisor table `ModelLookUp_EvoAC` inside `GetCurrentOutput()` is populated entirely with `None` — the author knows the model IDs and does not know the scale for any of them. The fallback is an empirical `Divisor = 20.0` for b

RUN HOURS ARE NOT ONE REGISTER ACROSS THE FAMILY. Air-cooled reads 0x000b (declared 4 bytes: 0x000b high, 0x000c low) as whole hours; Evolution Liquid Cooled and PowerZone200 read 0x005e (4 bytes) as total engine MINUTES and divide by 60. Picking the wrong branch is off by 60×.
unmappedReports: engine RPM (0x0007) — no `engine-rpm` MetricKind exists; the most direct proof a genset is spinning has nowhere to land, utility / mains voltage (0x0009) as distinct from generator output voltage (0x0012) — the contract has a single `ac-voltage`, so one of these two must be dropped or overloaded. This is a real contract gap for any device that straddles a transfer switch, hours-until-service-A (0x001a), hours-until-service-B (0x001e), service-due dates (0x001b, 0x0020, 0x0021, 0x0022) — no maintenance-countdown MetricKind, front-panel switch position Auto / Manual / Off (decoded from 0x0001) — `switch-state` is a two-state metric; a three-position controller mode does not fit it, alarm / status code (0x0001, 4 bytes) and last alarm code (0x05f1) — `generator-run-state` has a `faulted` variant but there is no MetricKind carrying the numeric fault code, so the one field a person actually needs at 3 a.m. is lost, weekly / biweekly / monthly exercise schedule (0x0005, 0x0006, 0x002c–0x002f) — no MetricKind to report it and no CommandKind to set it, though genmon writes it, Wi-Fi RSSI on Evolution 2.0 (0x0213) — `link-signal-quality` exists but is scoped to `internet-link`, not to a `generator`, hardware / firmware version (0x002a) and bootcode version (0x0051) — arguably not metrics, but genmon surfaces them and there is no home for them, transfer-switch position and output relay states — starter, fuel relay, battery charger (0x0052, 0x0053, EvoLC) — no MetricKind, hours of protection since activation (0x0054, EvoLC) — no MetricKind, COMMAND gaps: genmon exposes start-with-transfer (index 0x0002), run-exercise-now (index 0x0003), reset-maintenance-timer, reset-maintenance-alarm, and set-panel-to-auto/manual/off (indices 0x000F / 0x000E / 0x0010). CommandKind has none of these. `reset-counter` is the nearest thing to the maintenance-timer reset and is probably not the same intent
